plan.api_completion_budget_reason: ExLlamaV3 1.5.0 reports the completion budget exactly, so the allocation budget equals the 512-token measurement horizon; the 1.4.2 audited protocol asked for one extra token because that version under-reported by one.
bootstrap_commands: test "$(awk '/MemTotal/{print int($2/1048576)}' /proc/meminfo)" -ge 64 || { echo 'host RAM is below the 64 GiB this artifact needs for the 26 GB n-gram table plus offloaded experts' >&2; exit 1; }
plan.tabby_config:
network:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 5000
  disable_auth: true
  disable_fetch_requests: true
  send_tracebacks: false
  api_servers: ["OAI"]
  sse_ping_interval: 15

logging:
  log_prompt: false
  log_generation_params: false
  log_requests: false
  log_chat_completion_requests: false

model:
  model_dir: /opt/models
  inline_model_loading: false
  use_dummy_models: false
  model_name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-EXL3-205bpw-H4
  backend: exllamav3
  max_seq_len: 262144
  cache_size: 262656
  cache_mode: Q4
  tensor_parallel: false
  gpu_split_auto: true
  autosplit_reserve: [512]
  chunk_size: 2048
  output_chunking: true
  max_batch_size: 2
  vision: true
  reasoning: true
  start_in_reasoning: always
  reasoning_start_token: " thinking"
  reasoning_end_token: "</think>"
  template_vars_default:
    enable_thinking: true
  tool_format: qwen3_coder
  # The 26.24 GB n-gram table is indexed by short n-grams and never needs to
  # be on the card, so it lives in host RAM. 51B of routed-expert weights are
  # then split off the card so what stays resident fits a 24 GB board, and the
  # split is chosen from the measured free memory rather than guessed.
  ngram_ram: true
  cpu_moe_split_experts: 128
  draft_model:
    draft_mode: mtp
